objectClass.notes: Three admitted orthographic crops define front, side and back. The heater, motor, underside, power cable and internal gate remain explicitly inferred.

reasoning: The visible transparent chamber, four posts, rotary popper, outlet architecture and rear ventilation require a deep component hierarchy.
Popcorn must be a bounded repeated system with deterministic powered-state transitions rather than a single filler mesh.
Animation needs separate pivots, sockets and exact 5.2-second reset behavior.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Identity depends on both the transparent container architecture and animated popcorn production/dispense systems.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: The hidden heater, gearbox, motor and internal dispensing gate are not visible and will be represented only as inferred dark cavities or animation anchors.
The exact underside, foot pad tread and power cable geometry are not visible; only the visible feet and a rear cable socket will be authored.
The side triangular projection is ambiguous and will be treated as a chute release lever with lower confidence.

details.description: low pink dome with broad rounded eave
lacquer highlight on pink cap and buttons
clear four-sided chamber with edge reflections
four cream corner posts joining chamber frames
upper frame seam between dome and glass
individual lobed popcorn forms with golden cores
ten rounded vertical rear vent slots
continuous pink base band and panel seam

definitionOfDone: Front, side and back renders preserve the reference height/width/depth, rounded cabinet, transparent chamber and low dome silhouette.
Chamber, popper, outlet, tray, controls, vents, feet and popcorn remain separate named parts with stable pivots and sockets.
Powered animation clearly reads as popcorn production: control turn, warm lamp, rotating mechanism, kernels swelling/jumping, chamber tumbling and a bounded dispense handful.
At exactly 5.2 seconds stop restores all transforms, visibility, scales and emissive values without penetrating chamber walls.

featureGroups.name: Tall rounded cabinet and low dome silhouette
qualityCriteria: Front height-to-width and side depth remain within the illustrated proportions.
Dome, chamber and lower cabinet occupy distinct vertical thirds.

featureGroups.name: Transparent four-sided chamber structure
qualityCriteria: Glass panels, corner posts and upper/lower frames remain separable and readable from orbit.

featureGroups.name: Top popper and popcorn repeated system
qualityCriteria: Rotating disc/column is centered under the dome and the popcorn pile has an uneven multi-lobed surface.

featureGroups.name: Front arch and projecting tray
qualityCriteria: Deep arch cavity, lip and tray create the correct front negative space and depth.

featureGroups.name: Controls, rear vents and feet
qualityCriteria: Round button, side control, ten rear slots, base seam and four feet are visible in their corresponding elevations.

featureGroups.name: SAKURA toon material separation
qualityCriteria: Cream satin shell, lacquer pink, transparent chamber, warm food, dark cavity and powered warm lamp remain visually distinct.

visualDeltaChecks: front silhouette and vertical mass ratio
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not merge the clear chamber into the cabinet.
Do not model the popcorn pile as one blob.
Do not merge moving controls or popper pivots.
Do not accept a powered state without both mechanism motion and food transformation.
Do not claim the hidden heater, underside or power cable are reference-accurate.
mustNotDo: Do not allow any animated popcorn center beyond the inner chamber bounds.
Do not leave any powered transform or emissive value active after stop.
